notes.collins: Collins is at 541 N. Woodlawn Ave (IU Housing's residence-center page, housing.indiana.edu/residence-centers/collins.html); pin at OSM's Ulysses H. Smith Hall (way/271047498), the residential building at that address (Edmondson and Cravens share it).
notes.forest: Forest Quad is at 1725 E 3rd St (IU Housing's residence-center page); centre of OSM's Forest Quadrangle (relation/8767202, same address).
notes.foster: Foster is at 1000 N Fee Ln (IU Housing's residence-center page); pin at OSM's Harper Hall (way/154884428, 1000 North Fee Lane), one of the Foster Quad houses.
notes.university-east: University East Apartments are at 1603 E 3rd St (IU Housing's residence-center page); centre of OSM's University Apartments East (way/175832775, same address).
notes.willkie: Willkie is at 150 N Rose Ave (IU Housing's residence-center page); pin at OSM's Willkie (C) (relation/14097389), the low building between towers A and B, all at that address.
notes.AH: The registrar's AH "The Health Services Building" word-matched IU Health Bloomington, the hospital; no OSM building is surely it, so AH isn't placed.
notes.FR: FR "Forest Quad" word-matched the Forest Quad Chiller; Forest Quad is the Forest residence hall, so FR isn't placed.
notes.MS: MS "Memorial Stadium" word-matched Memorial Hall; the stadium isn't a place, so MS isn't placed.
notes.iu-health-bloomington: IU Health Bloomington Hospital, not somewhere classes or meals happen.
notes.intercollegiate-athletics-gymnasium: Varsity athletics gymnasium, not a student gym.

detours.why: Tulip Tree's mapped path leads north into the parking-lot drives, and the buildings east of it are reached by the cycleway along the south side of the lots, so walks loop back through the lots.
